note: Optional exact anchor of the trick-1 silver set (docs/m3-hybrid/silver.md): 24 leader and second-seat decisions of the silver set (ids 32-39, 64-71, 96-103: seats 1-2, every stratum) x 16 worlds solved exactly (the same worlds as the silver set's first 16: seed 1, label 1), position-aware threads and tables; then H_3 (O_3) and H_2 (O_2) each checked against these exact worlds. With the silver set's check of the same O_2 on the same decisions, it measures the silver's own error (H_3 against exact at trick 1) and how far the loss against silver is from the true loss. Exact trick-1 worlds cost about 10^10 to 1.6x10^11 solver nodes each (docs/m3-hybrid/rung2.md section 4): priced in silver.md before launching.
